MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 1
   C. 7
   D. 5

2. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 48

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 36
   D. 24

4. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 81

5. Solve for x: x + 3 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 9
   C. 6
   D. 3

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 24

7. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 12
   C. 1
   D. 13

8. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 33

9. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 4
   D. 33

10. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 22
   C. 11
   D. 122

11. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 72
   C. 73
   D. 17

12. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 26

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

1. D — 5

1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 3² + 4²
3. c² = 9 + 16
4. c² = 25
5. c = 5
Final Answer: 5 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse
